title: Child
description: children/{child_id} (SDD 12). Created by the Account service (W1) with the required fields. Later merged into by Core: the Grader writes next_passage_arl, the Reading Coach writes saved_tags and next_session_at, the Passage Generator path writes next_passage_id, and the Session Agent (W2) clears next_passage_id when a session uses it. A child is read by the Grader, the Coach and the Session Agent. A child must have a consents/ record before a session starts.
